nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: The playground is larger than the courtyard was, and quieter.

effects.speaker: protagonist
effects.text: You entered the playground beyond the estate gate. It is open and still.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: To one side, a sports shed with its door half open. Along the far edge, a notice wall. In the middle, an old set of climbing frames no one has painted in a while.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: Inside the shed: stacked cones, a deflated ball, a ledger with rain on its cover.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: You lean in. The air smells of rubber and paper.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: On the ledger's last page: the same timetable format as the one in your classroom, but the subject column says PHYS. ED. and the room is YARD. Someone kept the old paper.

effects.speaker: protagonist
effects.text: In the playground shed you found a ledger page using the same timetable format as your classroom.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: The page is too wet. You can make out the grid but the ink has run into the lines that matter. The shape is familiar even if the words are not.

effects.speaker: protagonist
effects.text: You tried to read a wet ledger in the playground shed. The timetable shape is there, but the details are lost.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: You step back. The cone stack keeps its shape.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: A wall of notices: lost keys, a tryouts list from two terms ago, a class photo. The names under the photo do not include yours.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: You look at the photo until the faces stop being faces.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: The back row, second from the left. The same haircut as the timetable drawing, but older. You cannot tell if that is a memory or a suggestion.

effects.speaker: protagonist
effects.text: On the playground notice wall you thought you recognised a face in a class photo, but you are not sure.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: Nothing comes. The photo stays where it is, and you stay where you are. It might be better that way.

effects.speaker: protagonist
effects.text: You looked at the class photo on the playground wall and no memory came.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: The tryouts list has been corrected so many times the final team is unreadable. The lost-keys notice is still there, keys still lost.

effects.speaker: protagonist
effects.text: The playground wall lists old tryouts and lost keys, both unresolved.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: The climbing frames have been here a long time. One bar is warm even though the sun is not on it.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: You put a hand near the warm bar without touching it.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: It is not the bar. The concrete under it holds the heat, as if a room below ran too long and then stopped. No door is visible.

effects.speaker: protagonist
effects.text: The concrete under the playground equipment felt warm as if from a room below.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: You feel nothing new. Or you feel something and call it nothing, which is almost the same. The bar is just a bar, for now.

effects.speaker: protagonist
effects.text: You focused on the playground equipment and decided to treat the warmth as ordinary.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: You breathe once and look along the frame instead of at it. The bolts are different on the warm bar: newer, tighter, as if it had been replaced.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: The replacement was careful. Someone wanted this held together.

effects.speaker: protagonist
effects.text: The playground equipment's warm bar has newer bolts, as if replaced with care.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: They are bolts. They hold. You decide not to make it more than that today.

effects.speaker: protagonist
effects.text: You looked at the bolts on the playground equipment and left the question open.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: So you found the yard. I thought they'd locked it.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: They didn't.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: Huh. Well. If you hear the ball, don't go chasing it. It hasn't been pumped since I was here.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: You did the whole loop, then. Did the notices finally learn your name?

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: No.
